entries.text: ClickHouse Local now requires chdb 4.5.0 or newer (chdb-core 26.11.1 or newer), whose native library loads on macOS 27; older releases failed on import with a mis-aligned LINKEDIT string pool error.
make heavy-run and host_lock run exit 0 when the watchdog reports a breach only after the guarded command already exited 0, and log the late breach as a warning.
